subtopics.title: The Full Family — and the Surplus

questions.question: The stocktake counts R10 745 against a book figure of R10 700. The entry is:
options: Debit Trading Stock R45, credit Trading Stock Surplus (an income) — the count wins in both directions
Credit Trading Stock R45, debit Trading Stock Deficit
No entry — surpluses are ignored by prudence
Debit Sales R45

questions.question: Prudence allows the surplus to be recognised because:
options: Gains are always recognised immediately
The COUNT proves it — prudence refuses hoped-for gains, not counted ones
The surplus increases profit
The auditor demands it

questions.question: A surplus should make an accountant slightly suspicious because:
options: Surpluses are illegal
It reduces the profit
Stock does not breed — a surplus means a record is wrong somewhere and must be investigated
The count is always wrong

questions.question: Every member of the adjustment family shares this shape:
options: A cash entry and a narration
Two income-statement lines
A memorandum with no entry
A full double entry pairing an income-statement correction with a balance-sheet item

questions.question: Advertising costs of R320 posted to Stationery are corrected by:
options: Debit Advertising R320, credit Stationery R320 — out of the wrong pocket, into the right one
Debit Stationery R320, credit Advertising R320
Debit Advertising R640, credit Bank R640
No correction — total expenses are unchanged

questions.question: The omitted credit sale of R600 (mark-up pricing, cost R400) is corrected by:
options: Debit Sales, credit Debtors Control
Doing the skipped entry in full: Debtors Control/Sales R600 AND Cost of Sales/Trading Stock R400
Only the sales half — the cost was never recorded anyway
A note to the auditor

questions.question: Wages entered as R2 070 instead of R2 700 are corrected by:
options: Reversing the R2 070 and re-entering R2 700
Crediting Wages R630
A top-up entry for the DIFFERENCE — debit Wages R630, credit Bank R630
Adjusting the trial balance total directly

questions.question: All three error families were caught by:
options: The trial balance
The post-closing trial balance
The bank statement alone
The humbler guards — document checks, reconciliations, detail compared against summary; all three slipped past the trial balance

subtopics.title: The Post-Adjustment Trial Balance, In Format

questions.question: The correct format opens with:
options: A heading naming the business, the document and the date, then the balance sheet accounts section, then the nominal accounts section
The nominal accounts, then the balance sheet accounts
The bank balance, then everything else
Whatever order the ledger happens to be in

questions.question: The "new children of adjustment" filed in the balance sheet section include:
options: Sales and Cost of Sales
Accrued Income, Prepaid Expenses and Consumable Stores on Hand among the assets; Accrued Expenses and Income Received in Advance among the liabilities
Only the depreciation for the year
The narrations from the General Journal

questions.question: The post-adjustment trial balance still levels because:
options: The bookkeeper rounds the difference away
Adjustments are recorded in one column only
Every adjustment and correction was a balanced double entry
The nominal accounts are excluded

questions.question: The final accounts run on the adjusted figures is:
options: A completely new procedure
Optional once adjustments are done
Performed before the adjustments
The same term-two machine with truer fuel — Trading for gross profit, Profit and Loss for net, profit to Capital

subtopics.title: Closing Off and the Post-Closing Trial Balance

questions.question: After the closing transfers, the nominal accounts stand at:
options: Zero — their year compressed into the profit now resting in Capital
Their adjusted balances
Half their balances
Next year's estimates

questions.question: Drawings closes off by:
options: Transfer to Profit and Loss as an expense
Transfer against Capital — the owner's takings settled against the owner's stake
Transfer to Bank
Remaining open into the new year

questions.question: The post-closing trial balance contains:
options: All accounts, adjusted
Only the nominal accounts
Only assets, liabilities and the updated Capital — the equation, itemised and proven level
The year's incomes and expenses at their final figures

questions.question: An income or expense appearing on a post-closing trial balance is:
options: Acceptable if small
Correct for accrued items
Required for comparison
An error BY DEFINITION — flows die at midnight; only positions survive

subtopics.title: The Whole Toolbox on One Bench

questions.question: The one motion all nine tools share is:
options: Find what the year TRULY used or earned, write that on the report card, and let the balance sheet hold the leftover
Move every amount to the new year
Credit the bank in each case
Double each figure for safety

questions.question: "Shelves don't breed stock" is the reminder that:
options: Deficits are impossible
A surplus is booked AND investigated — somewhere a record is wrong
Stocktakes are optional
Surpluses are refused by prudence

questions.question: A question listing five adjustments is really:
options: Five unrelated puzzles
A trick — only one is real
One motion repeated five times
A reason to start with the hardest

questions.question: "Right cupboard, wrong drawer" (advertising in Stationery) never rang the alarm because:
options: Both are expense drawers — the cupboard's total stayed right while the detail lied
The amount was too small
Stationery and Advertising are the same account
The trial balance only checks assets

questions.question: "The shirt still in the shopping bag" is corrected by:
options: Half the entry, to be safe
Unpacking it completely now — both pairs: the sale AND the cost-of-sales movement
Waiting for the debtor to pay
Adjusting Capital directly

questions.question: "Folded wrong" (R2 070 for R2 700) is fixed by:
options: Ripping the entry out and starting over
Reducing wages to match the entry
Adding exactly the missing R630 — fix by the difference, nothing more
A note in the margin

questions.question: "Balance proves arithmetic; only checking proves truth" means:
options: The trial balance catches every error eventually
Arithmetic and truth are the same thing
Checking is unnecessary once the books balance
All three error kinds slipped past the trial balance and were caught by document checks and comparisons

questions.question: The story pages "burn down to zero" but are "promoted" because:
options: Their whole year is compressed into one number now living in Capital
They are deleted from the records entirely
They move to the asset register
They become next year's expenses

questions.question: The list that walks through midnight untouched holds:
options: The year's sales and expenses
What the shop OWNS, what it OWES, and the owner's updated stake — owning continues; earning starts fresh
Only the bank balance
The journals of the old year

questions.question: The post-closing trial balance is simultaneously:
options: The year's profit calculation
A replacement for the financial statements
This year's ending position AND next year's opening position — the cycle closing into itself
A list of the year's corrections

questions.question: The impostor to spot on any post-closing list is:
options: An accumulated depreciation account
The capital account
A loan balance
Any income or expense — flows may never appear among the surviving positions
